acceptanceCriteria: `corvint affected` accepts `--provider-command` and `--provider-mcp` with the same strict decode, freshness and separation behaviour as `impact`, covered by tests.
The transports spec drops the `Blocked on` line and its README row is updated in the same change.
body:
Filed from the audit of https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/64 (generic ExternalEvidenceProvider contract) on 2026-09-22.

`cmd/corvint/help.go:918` shows `impact` accepting `--provider-command` and `--provider-mcp`, but `cmd/corvint/affected.go:177` (`affectedOptionNames`) lists neither, so `affected` can only use the file transport. `docs/specs/external-evidence-provider-transports-v0.md:14` records this as its remaining blocker.
title: cmd/corvint: `affected` lacks `--provider-command` and `--provider-mcp`
